verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents a separate Microsoft 365 E5 developer sandbox tenant, which includes OneDrive, for building solutions independently of production. Graph Explorer also offers an anonymous sample tenant and explicitly recommends using the developer sandbox to avoid affecting production data. Access to the full sandbox is gated by Developer Program eligibility, and a production subscription does not qualify you, so this is not a universally available sandbox. missing for 10: ungated sandbox access for all users, OneDrive-specific sandbox documentation (seeding, reset, parity with production), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: request a Microsoft 365 E5 developer subscription to create a sandbox for developing solutions independent of their production environment
signing into your Microsoft 365 Developer sandbox tenant instead of your production tenant to avoid running operations that can affect your production data.
Test APIs on a sample tenant and explore available resources.
